evidence.summary: Canada’s Named Research Organizations list gives PLA Navy Research Academy and PLA Navy Equipment Academy among the academy’s known aliases. Under its earlier name, the PLA Navy Equipment Research Academy, it described itself on China’s graduate admissions site as the navy’s research unit for the overall development of its weapons and equipment, with sites in Beijing and Shanghai and research on ships, aircraft, missiles, guns, radar, sonar, electronic countermeasures, command and control and underwater weapons.

The same profile names a national defence science and technology key laboratory for navy weapons and equipment system research, alongside more than 20 military key laboratories for ships, aircraft, weapons and electronic systems.
items: Navy Weapons and Equipment System Research National Defence Science and Technology Key Laboratory (海军武器装备体系研究国防科技重点实验室)

evidence.summary: Its admissions profile gives its full name as the Chinese People’s Liberation Army Navy Equipment Research Academy and says it works to the Central Military Commission’s five functions for military research institutions: requirements analysis, project oversight, test and evaluation, application of results and specialised research.
